evals.prompt: 根据这个蓝湖设计稿实现当前 React 项目的活动页：https://lanhuapp.com/web/#/item/project/stage?tid=demo&pid=desktop 。目标画板是“活动首页-桌面端”，本地页面是 http://127.0.0.1:3000/activity。切图请直接放进项目现有 assets 目录。实现后按设计稿尺寸反复截图对比，直到视觉差异足够小。
evals.expected_output: Uses lanhu-mcp before implementation, follows the user's local-asset instruction, preserves the React project's conventions, switches the real desktop mode, reloads, and iterates with fixed-viewport Playwright screenshots until the visual completion gate passes.

evals.prompt: 把蓝湖里的“个人主页-Web”和“个人主页-Mobile”都还原到这个 Vue 项目，地址：https://lanhuapp.com/web/#/item/project/stage?tid=demo&pid=responsive 。项目里有自己的 PC/H5 切换按钮，不要只改 viewport。两个端都要给我最终截图。
evals.expected_output: Detects and follows the Vue project's conventions, treats the two artboards as independent targets, uses the project's PC/H5 switch plus exact viewport resize and reload, and produces separate converged evidence for both targets.

evals.prompt: 参考这个蓝湖稿把当前本地商品详情页做出来：https://lanhuapp.com/web/#/item/project/stage?tid=demo&pid=product 。我没指定切图怎么处理，你自己按流程完成。页面原来的下单交互和数据逻辑不能变。
evals.expected_output: Uses lanhu-mcp to gather the design evidence, attempts duitang-image-upload because no asset policy was supplied, keeps Lanhu temporary URLs out of production code, preserves business behavior, and runs the Playwright visual convergence loop before reporting completion.

evals.prompt: 用蓝湖设计稿校准 hasaki-douyin-exchange 的站外兑换页。项目按 750/rem 开发，蓝湖给的是默认 375 宽稿。只做视觉验证，不要改生产 UI；固定接口数据后页面必须恢复校准前的 Git 状态。
evals.expected_output: Reads the project rule before converting the design to the 750 capture contract, validates a complete design manifest, uses a fixed full-height browser capture, prefers browser-level request interception, and restores the recorded Git state after preserving final evidence.

evals.prompt: 页面的倒计时数值会变化，但其卡片位置、背景和圆角必须和蓝湖一致。请持续修复视觉差异；如果同一区域两次修复没有改善，停止盲调。
evals.expected_output: Masks only the countdown value through a selector while comparing its wrapper, starts from a full-page diff, focuses on the largest changed regions, and escalates after two non-improving repairs to DOM, computed-style, font, image, and state diagnosis rather than claiming completion.
